extraction.name: SciQ
extraction.description: A dataset of 13.7K multiple choice science exam questions.
extraction.creator: Johannes Welbl (University College London); Nelson F. Liu (University of Washington); Matt Gardner (Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence)
extraction.citeAs: Johannes Welbl, Nelson F. Liu, Matt Gardner. Crowdsourcing Multiple Choice Science Questions. 2017.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected by compiling 28 science study textbooks from online resources and presenting filtered passages to crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk, who then formulated multiple-choice questions and selected or wrote answer distractors.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator; Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: A small percentage of the passages were obtained from unreleasable texts, so the direct answer version of the dataset is slightly smaller than the multiple choice version.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 28 science study textbooks from various online learning resources, including CK-12 and OpenStax, covering biology, chemistry, earth science, and physics.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: A two-step process: first, crowd workers were presented with textbook paragraphs and asked to formulate a question and answer. Second, another worker validated the generated question-answer pair and selected up to two model-suggested distractors while writing at least one of their own to create a multiple-choice question.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Annotations from the first step were validated by a second worker who judged whether the question could appear in a school science exam, marking questions that were ungrammatical, had a false answer, or were unrelated to science.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Sentences were filtered out of the base corpus if they contained first names or personal pronouns other than third-person.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Investigating neural model performance in medium-sized data settings; Augmenting training data for answering real science exam questions
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was randomly shuffled and split into training, validation, and test sets. To create a direct-answer version of the dataset, answer options were removed and the source passages were included; during this process, a small percentage of questions associated with unreleasable texts were filtered out.
